answer: Texas uses electronic titles, so there's no paper title to bring, and your lender sends the lien release to the state electronically rather than as a paper document. Ask your bank to release the lien. If you can't get them to do it, you can sign our lien release request, form NW-LRL-1, and we'll contact the lender for you, though this can add 1 to 2 weeks. We can still make you an offer and book your appointment while you wait.
